rationale: Phase framing (openspec/changes/l7-phase-framing, D-P-1..D-P-4): the context contract declares the required derived phase-state slot and the procedure is phase-scoped (REMEDIATE works from its declared inputs; it never assumes a prior phase's get_finding result is present). Workflow, ceiling and grant bytes identical to v4. Evidence: host records demo-remediate-0001/0002 under rsys@6 (governed FAILED at the ANALYZE→REMEDIATE boundary) and the laptop/host captures. v4 stays active as recognized history; rsys@7 does not admit it.
